lead.headline: Rice and Barkley stay zeroed; the opponent found a quarterback but has not started him
lead.deck: Two DNPs each. Myers, dropped for Gay, already kicked 7.0. Los Cachanillas added Cousins and left Hurts in.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice and Saquon Barkley each missed Wednesday and Thursday, and ESPN projects both at 0.0. Jason Myers, the kicker you dropped for Matt Gay, scored 7.0 on Thursday night. Next week Jacksonville's bye takes Lawrence, Tuten and Strange. This week the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 119.5, against 85.7. Los Cachanillas claimed Kirk Cousins overnight but still list Jalen Hurts, ruled out, at quarterback and the Vikings' defence, on bye. ESPN has you at 69%.
